run_PackedCausalTransformerGenerator_gen: run the PackedCausalTransformerGenerator to generate text from a list of prompts using a loaded ByteLatent model
sample_tokens_with_top_p: sample tokens from model logits using top-p nucleus sampling with configurable temperature and probability threshold
pack_prompts_into_batch: pack multiple tokenized prompts into a single concatenated tensor with per-sequence length tracking for efficient batched generation
load_consolidated_model_and_tokenizer: load a consolidated ByteLatent or LMTransformer model and tokenizer from a checkpoint directory for inference
create_KVCache_for_attention: create a KVCache module to store key and value tensors for efficient autoregressive generation with attention masking
